description:
Navigate the ICD-11 hierarchy to find parent or child entities.

Use this tool to:
- Find broader categories (parents) of a condition
- Find specific subtypes (children) of a condition
- Understand the classification structure

Name the entity by `code` (a leaf code like "5A11", or a block range like "5A10-5A2Y" — blocks come back from 'parents' with an empty code and a code_range) or by `uri` (the URI any previous answer returned). Direction 'parents' returns ancestor categories, 'children' returns subcategories. ICD-10 codes (like "E11") are not ICD-11 codes: convert them first with map_icd10_to_icd11.

language.description: Language code (default: en). Returns the source's OFFICIAL translation when it exists (e.g. 'pt' for official Portuguese); content is never machine-translated.

uri.description: Entity URI as returned by icd11_lookup, icd11_search or a previous icd11_hierarchy call

name: icd11_hierarchy

attribution.description: Canonical source URLs of this response (attribution list)

provenance.description: Provenance block (contract v1.1): source, URL, data vintage, extraction instant, origin diagnostics, citation, license

data_vintage.description: Version/release of the data as exposed by the source; null when not exposed

field_sources.description: Present only when the response joins parts from different origins or extraction instants (contract v1.2): for each group of fields, its URL, extraction instant and whether it came from cache. Absent in single-origin responses

items.description: Proveniência de um grupo de campos da resposta: de onde veio e quando foi extraído

fields.description: Campos do payload atribuídos a esta sub-fonte

retrieved_at.description: ISO-8601 da extração desta sub-fonte na origem

served_from_cache.description: true se esta sub-fonte veio do cache do servidor (retrieved_at é o da extração original); false se foi buscada nesta chamada; null se o servidor não distingue

source_url.description: URL canônica da sub-fonte que originou estes campos

license.description: License / legal regime of the data

anomalies.description: Anomalias superadas até o sucesso, somadas por classe, em ordem fixa; [] se nenhuma

kind.description: Classe da anomalia (vocabulário fechado do contrato)

attempts.description: Tentativas somadas, incluindo as repetidas (>= requests)

requests.description: Idas distintas à origem que compõem esta resposta (fatias, páginas)

unstable.description: true se houve repetição (attempts > requests) ou alguma anomalia

retrieval.description: Origin diagnostics of THIS source in this call (contract v1.1): requests made to the upstream, attempts summed across retries, anomalies worked around (kind + count); unstable=true when any anomaly happened. null when nothing was measured (bundled dataset, or response served entirely from cache)

retrieved_at.description: Real instant of the upstream extraction (ISO-8601, UTC). Responses served from cache keep the ORIGINAL fetch instant.

source.description: Official upstream source of this data

source_url.description: Canonical URL of the source (API base or dataset release)

title: Browse ICD-11 Hierarchy
